يستدركون (form X)
# يَسْتَدْرِكُونَ (yastadrikūna) /jas.tad.ri.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# يُسْتَدْرَكُونَ (yustadrakūna) /jus.tad.ra.kuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
